reasoning_traces.think:
The Offline CLV-Brier Diagnostic operates as a dual-check mechanism: it evaluates both the predictive power of a model (via Brier score) and its economic relevance (via CLV). The Brier score measures forecast calibration by comparing predicted probabilities to realized outcomes, while CLV quantifies long-term value. Together, they form a robust diagnostic that avoids overconfidence in either metric alone. Failure modes include misalignment between model outputs and true outcomes, or ignoring settled P&L policies when assessing EV. The system must remain agnostic to speculative line history and rely on verified historical data for validation.
